items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Topics 2:1
items.html: The upper light does not go out from the aspect of Ein Sof, except through its clothing in a vessel of reception. And since the vessels of reception of AK are from the aspect of the reflected light rising from the Malchut of restriction 1, which is no longer revealed in the Partzufim of Atzilut from AA and below, as above in the preceding answer, it is found that they cannot receive from the lights of AK with his vessels of reception, but only from the aspect of light without a vessel, which is called by the name Ein Sof. As above. (Vol. 1, p. 301, Item 9, and in the Ohr Pnimi there).
